thread:
SRE Lead: Quick note after today's postmortem sync: we still need to make the runbook explicit about how to check for 'stale KVs' in Redis cluster and what to do when replication lag is observed. This is causing repeated partial cache misses.

Nikhil: I'll add a 'check replication lag' command and thresholds. Tentative: replication lag > 200ms -> run read-only failover, > 2s -> escalate. Also add a `redis-cli info` snippet.

Nikhil: Proposed commands:
```
# replication info
redis-cli -h $REDIS_HOST info replication
# check last interaction
redis-cli -h $REDIS_HOST latency latest
```

Runbook Bot: Remember to include privileged-access notes for `redis-cli` commands. Private runbook should have SSH jump instructions.

Eng Platform: For read-only failover we should prefer promoting a replica in the same AZ. Add safe failover steps and a rollback note.

Maria G: I'll add a short 'observability' section: exact Prom queries and a Grafana dashboard link that shows cache hit ratio and replication lag across shards.

SRE Lead: Add a small remediation play:
- If replication lag > 200ms and QPS degraded -> trigger cache warmup job and toggle cache_fallback true.
- If replication lag > 2s -> promote replica or perform controlled failover and page Eng Platform.

Nikhil: I'll put replication lag thresholds into alertmanager as a new alert (RED-Cache-Replication-Lag) with a 2m window to avoid noisy spikes.

Runbook Bot: New runbook checklist created in drafts/runbooks/cache-eviction.md. Please submit PR using docs template.

SRE Lead: Great. Owners: Nikhil for replication checks (ETA Wed), Maria for dashboards (ETA Thu), Eng Platform for failover playbook (ETA next Mon). Confirm?

Nikhil: Confirmed, Wed.

Maria G: Confirmed, Thu.

Eng Platform: Confirmed, Mon.

SRE Lead: I'll close the follow-up once PRs merged and we run a quick staging smoke. Thanks all.
